card.name: Month names and day counts before year
card.fires_on: Month names in dates (September, March, May), and the gap before a day count like 28 or 25 days that stands in for one month. The next word is often a year or a date number.

modes.label: Day count for a month
modes.description: The space before a number of days that equals about one month.

modes.label: Month in a date
modes.description: A month name used in a start date or an issue date, before a year.

modes.label: Month in a publication issue
modes.description: A month name naming a magazine issue.
modes.example: appeared in the<< May>> issue of Acupuncture Today

card.writes: It pushes the model toward "year" and away from "month" and "monthly" words.
card.plain: It fires on month names and month-length day counts, and helps predict a year rather than another month word.
